description: Regression for the auto-selected shooter now being a REAL SELECT_SHOOTER (r5:F3 / r4:WS-5): when the phase answers the selection with a prompt (here the Tankbustas' unused Pulsa Rokkit) it returns success before the controller records the shooter, Main refreshes the shooter list and the list auto-selected the same unit again - recursing until the stack overflowed. Setup-only: P1 switched to Wreckas (no unit_selected_to_shoot offer for the Tankbustas); every P1 unit except the Tankbustas marked as having shot; Custodian Guard C moved unengaged in front of the Ork rank; no active shooter. The list refresh auto-selects the Tankbustas exactly once: phase and panel agree, the Pulsa Rokkit dialog is shown, and a real click on Decline continues to the weapon panel.

steps.comment: LV-2: the phase-entry auto-selection is not a player choice, so it opens NO unit_selected_to_shoot window (it opens before the player's first action with that shooter instead) - nothing to decline before the scenario picks its own shooter
setup: only the Tankbustas (unused Pulsa Rokkit) can still shoot; no active shooter anywhere
the list refresh auto-selects the Tankbustas ONCE (before the guard this recursed into a stack overflow); phase and panel agree; the Pulsa Rokkit prompt is pending
the Pulsa Rokkit dialog is shown for the auto-selected unit; give its button row a stable path so Decline can be clicked for real
real click: Decline the Pulsa Rokkit
declined: the Tankbustas stay the active shooter in both the phase and the panel
the weapon panel is populated with the Tankbustas' targets
